newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was very slow late Thursday. Few sales of slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Inquiry was moderate, demand was rather light. Sales confirmed on 1,600 slaughter steers and 1,000 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 62,700 head confirmed including 16,800 head or about 28 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - few select and choice 2-3 1125-1275 lbs 63.00; pen select with end choice 1175 lbs 62.75.
Heifers - pen select and choice 2-3 1025-1175 lbs 63.00.
week to date: 62700 last week: 87500 last year: 82000
